about: The introitus of the formulary “Saint Mark the Evangelist” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: You have protected me, O God, from the gathering of the wicked, alleluia: from the multitude of those who work iniquity, alleluia, alleluia. Hear, O God, my prayer when I plead: deliver my soul from fear of the enemy. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. You have protected me, O God, from the gathering of the wicked, alleluia: from the multitude of those who work iniquity, alleluia, alleluia.
